US.name: Fed funds target
US.note: Held 28 Oct 2026 by 10–2; Cook and Hammack voted for a 25bp hike. Raised 25bp on 16 Sep, the first hike since 2023.

UK.name: Bank Rate
UK.note: Held 17 Sep 2026 by 6–3; Greene, Mann and Pill voted for 4.00%. CPI 3.5% in September, risks judged to the upside.

JP.name: BoJ policy rate
JP.note: Raised to 1.00% in Jun 2026; held 31 Jul on an 8–1 vote, one member favouring 1.25%.
